text:
ProCraft 

 
 An open-source painting app for Android tablets, Windows and Linux, with its own Rust engine and GPU renderer: a Kotlin/Jetpack Compose UI on Android, the same interface in egui on the desktop. 
 Pressure-sensitive brushes, layers with blend modes, adjustments, selection and transform, animation and 3D painting, written from scratch.
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 From Releases : Android tablets take the arm64.apk (the legacy-armeabi-v7a.apk is only for older 32-bit tablets), or Obtainium, for updates; Windows the .msi installer or the portable .zip ; Linux the .AppImage , the .deb or the .tar.gz (videos and PDFs there use the system's ffmpeg and poppler-utils ). 
 

 
 Painting ·
 Layers & colour ·
 Adjustments & transform ·
 Actions ·
 Planned features ·
 Building 
 

 

 
 
 
 Dusk , painted from a blank canvas on a Lenovo Legion Tab: the brush library, the colour picker, the layers, a sun snapped round and filled, hills filled the same way, pines, stars with Bloom. About 1:20; the full video (MP4, 2:21) shows every menu at close to real speed. Every stroke is a pen stroke with pressure, eased in and out, played by the demo script . 
 

 

 
 
 
 The canvas: the tools along the top, size and opacity in the sidebar, the whole screen for the painting. 
 

 

 Painting

 
 
 The brush library: eleven sets of our own brushes, each previewed with a stroke. 
 The Brush Studio: stroke path, stabilization, taper, shape, grain, rendering, wet mix, colour dynamics and more, tried out on the drawing pad. 
 
 

 

 Layers and colour

 
 
 Layers with blend modes, opacity, alpha lock, clipping masks, masks and groups. Layers past what the GPU holds are kept compressed, so artworks with hundreds of layers open and paint smoothly. 
 Colour: disc, classic, harmony, value (with hex) and palettes. 
 
 

 

 Adjustments and transform

 
 
 Hue, saturation, brightness on the sky layer, live. Also colour balance, curves, gradient map, blurs, noise, sharpen, bloom, glitch, halftone, chromatic aberration, liquify and clone, on the layer or painted on. 
 Transform: freeform, uniform, distort and warp, with snapping. Selection: automatic, freehand, rectangle and ellipse, with feather. 
 
 

 

 Actions

 
 
 
 Actions: add files, photos and text; the canvas, its guides and assists; share as PNG, JPEG, PSD, PDF, TIFF, GIF or MP4; a time-lapse of every artwork; preferences and gesture controls. 
 

 

 Planned features

ProCraft is in beta, on Android tablets and on the desktop (Windows and Linux).

 Area Status 
 --- --- 
 Canvas: the top bar, the sidebar (size, opacity, modify, undo, redo), full screen, gestures (pinch, rotate, quick fit, two- and three-finger taps, scrub to clear) ✅ 
 Brush engine: shape and grain sources, stroke path, stabilization, taper, rendering and glazes, wet mix, colour dynamics, pen pressure and tilt; the library and the Brush Studio ✅ 
 Layers: blend modes, opacity, alpha lock, clipping masks, masks, groups, merge, the reference layer; large artworks kept compressed off the GPU ✅ 
 Colour: disc, classic, harmony, value and palettes; history; eyedropper; filling by dragging the colour onto the canvas ✅ 
 Adjustments, each with its toolbar, on the layer or painted on ✅ 
 Selection (automatic, freehand, shapes, feather) and transform (freeform, uniform, distort, warp, snapping) ✅ 
 Shapes that snap clean, drawing guides and drawing assist (2D, isometric, perspective, symmetry), text ✅ 
 Animation and page assists, the reference window ✅ 
 Gallery: stacks, new-canvas presets, import and share (PNG, JPEG, PSD, PDF, TIFF, GIF, MP4), time-lapse 🚧 nearly done 
 3D painting: OBJ and USDZ models, texture sets, painting on the mesh, lights and environments 🚧 
 Desktop: Windows and Linux, the same interface with a mouse, a pen tablet and keyboard shortcuts; an installer, an AppImage and a .deb 🚧 beta 
 Plugins: .procraft-plugin files you import in Prefs › Plugins, each off until you turn it on and gone without a trace when you turn it off. Filters (a few lines of WGSL, under Adjustments) and sandboxed WebAssembly that changes how the app behaves, such as Interface, Touch offset and ColorDrop tools. How to write one: docs/plugins.md ✅ 
 More for plugins: buttons that change the artwork (asking permission first), panels of their own, the colour picker drawn their way, kinds of artwork and of layer of their own, such as Vector layers ✅ 
 Brush engines in plugins: brush files another app's engine draws, drawn by a plugin as that app draws them, with a brush studio of its own, such as Krita brushes (Krita's pixel brush) 🚧 
 Phones: their own app, ProCraft Pocket (this one is for tablets) ⬜ 

 ✅ works today · 🚧 in progress · ⬜ not started · 🚫 not planned 

 

 Building Instructions
 One Gradle command builds the whole app: it compiles the Rust engine with cargo-ndk and generates the Kotlin bindings. 

 Clone this repository
 Make sure you have at least 6 GB of free disk space
 enter android and run ./gradlew assembleRelease -Pprocraft.abis=arm64-v8a , or open that folder in Android Studio and press Run.
 the desktop app: cargo run --release -p procraft-desktop from the repository's root; its installer and packages with packaging/windows/package.ps1 (WiX v5) and packaging/linux/package.sh (nfpm, appimagetool).

Build time dependencies:

 
 required tools 

 
 

 cargo test --workspace runs the engine's and the renderer's tests on the desktop.

 Path What 
 --- --- 
 crates/engine document, brushes, stroke geometry, canvas view (no GPU) 
 crates/gpu wgpu renderer: layers, strokes, compositing, display 
 crates/core what both apps share above the renderer: the canvas session, every touch and gesture, the tools' state (adjustments, transform, selection, crop, Recolor) and which of them a button ends, the gallery, presets, gradients, time-lapse, the brush library's files, the layer menu, exports and their file names, and keyboard shortcuts; with the Android app's UniF
